info.title: Emulanders
info.author: joaoHypo
info.description: Skylanders NFC Emulation, Joy-Con scanner, dump manager & Tesla overlay
info.details:
Emulanders is an end-to-end Skylanders NFC emulation, Joy-Con dumping, and collection management ecosystem for the Nintendo Switch.

Features:
- Mifare Protocol Emulation: Background sysmodule intercepting nfc:mf:u calls in Skylanders: Imaginators.
- Tesla Overlay: Hot-swap and mount virtual .dump figures on-the-fly during gameplay.
- Emulanders Portal: Standalone full-screen app for Joy-Con tag dumping, 1:1 and New Identity figure cloning, screenshot photo cropper, and OTA asset/dump downloaders.
- Full bilingual localization (English & Portuguese).

Package installs the complete bundle: sysmodule (atmosphere/contents/420000000000E311), Tesla overlay (switch/.overlays/emulanders.ovl), and Emulanders Portal app (switch/EmulandersPortal/EmulandersPortal.nro).

changelog:
v1.0.0
- Initial release for Nintendo Switch Homebrew App Store!
- Full nfc:mf:u Mifare Classic 1K emulation sysmodule with passive RAM architecture.
- Tesla Overlay with lazy thumbnail rendering and bilingual support (EN/PT-BR).
- Emulanders Portal standalone manager with Joy-Con physical tag dumper.
- Figure Cloning Engine with UID randomization and crypto checksum recalculation.
- Interactive screenshot cropper for custom figure artwork.
- OTA Asset and Dump Downloaders.
- Custom color themes and persistence.
